title: incomplete project
tagline: project to proof wallet certain wallet properties  while wallet address is private.
description:
Using the iClear iOS app, user enters private wallet address
Ofc the wallet address never leaves the device.

From there user can choose what properties should the proof contain. 

And then hit generate proof. Which behind the scene send a request to a server that runs the Leo program.

This proof may directly be hooked into other parties that can verify this proof.
